_meta.purpose: Allow documentation-style references and explicit negations of fallback patterns. Each entry must have a justification.

justifications.comment lines: Full-line comments in Python (#) and C# (//) discussing fallback policy are not runtime branching.
justifications.false value: Explicitly setting fallback=false is disabling fallback, not enabling it.
justifications.negation patterns: Phrases like 'no fallback', 'not fallback', 'removed fallback' describe the absence of fallback.
